items.title: Protection business boosts HDFC Life, ICICI Pru Life Q1 earnings
items.description: HDFC Life and ICICI Prudential Life saw healthy profit expansion in the June quarter. Steady premium growth and stable new business margins drove these positive financial results. HDFC Life reported a twelve percent rise in net profit, while ICICI Prudential Life's profit increased twenty-eight percent. Both companies experienced strong contributions from their protection product offerings. Customer acquisition and product mix guided their respective business strategies during the period.

items.title: ICICI Lombard Q1 profit slumps 46% to Rs 403 crore on fire claims, SC verdict impact
items.description: ICICI Lombard's net profit fell 46 per cent in the June quarter.  This decline resulted from two large fire insurance claims.  A Supreme Court judgment also impacted its motor third-party portfolio.  The insurer's combined ratio worsened to 107.2 percent from 102.9 percent.  Gross direct premium income rose seven point five percent during the quarter.

items.title: Q1 results today: Jio Financial, Wipro, Polycab India, BHEL among 41 companies to report earnings
items.description: The June quarter earnings season gathers pace on July 16, with 41 companies, including Jio Financial Services, Wipro, Tech Mahindra, BHEL, Polycab India and 360 One, set to announce results. Corporate earnings are expected to grow around 10%, marking the strongest expansion in four quarters after TCS kicked off the reporting season on July 9.

items.title: Tech Mahindra Q1 Results: Net profit rises 28% YoY to Rs 1,465 crore, revenue up 18%
items.description: Tech Mahindra announced a consolidated net profit of Rs 1,465 crore for the first quarter. This represents a substantial 28% increase compared to the previous year's earnings. The company also saw its net profit rise over 8% sequentially from the prior quarter. Revenue from operations experienced an 18% year-on-year jump to Rs 15,712 crore. These results reflect strong financial performance for the IT services major.

items.title: Wipro Q1 Results: Profit flat YoY at Rs 3,352 crore; co declares Rs 2/share dividend
items.description: Wipro Q1 Results: Along with the earnings, the company’s board also approved an interim dividend of Rs 2 per share.
